question: A user request: "Use the tao-run-deft-cr-its-mining skill." Identify which TAO skill applies and, reading only that skill's documentation, outline the steps it prescribes. Do NOT run any commands, scripts, web searches, or other tools — describe the plan only.
ground_truth: Identify tao-run-deft-cr-its-mining as the applicable skill and summarize its documented workflow from SKILL.md without executing anything.
expected_behavior: Identifies tao-run-deft-cr-its-mining as the relevant skill
Outlines the documented workflow steps from SKILL.md
Does not run commands, scripts, or web searches

question: A tao-run-deft-cr-its-mining run was interrupted after several stages. Explain how the agent determines the next stage without rerunning iteration 1. Do not execute commands.
ground_truth: Use the initialized run directory and resume_position.py. The append-only loop log is the event source, deft_state.json is refreshed from valid events, and malformed log lines do not force a restart.
expected_behavior: Uses the existing initialized run directory
Names resume_position.py as the next-stage authority
Explains that loop_log.jsonl drives the refreshed state snapshot
Does not default to rerunning iteration 1

question: Explain how tao-run-deft-cr-its-mining handles two KPI questions that share one video. Do not execute commands.
ground_truth: Preserve each annotation id and question, resolve the external gap video_id to video_path, select both text targets, and use annotation_id/video_path as distinct internal lookup fields.
expected_behavior: Explains that video mining may expand one video to all matching annotations
Does not treat a shared video as a duplicate question

question: Explain how tao-run-deft-cr-its-mining locates its helper scripts and invokes other TAO stages when installed as a plugin. Do not execute commands.
ground_truth: Resolve the installed skill directory as DEFT_SKILL_ROOT, use run_script when available or an absolute skill-root script path otherwise, and invoke Cosmos Reason, Cosmos Embed, gap analysis, mining, and platform stages through their registered skills without requiring a tao-skill-bank checkout.
expected_behavior: Resolves helpers from the installed skill directory
Does not require the tao-skill-bank repository as the working directory
Invokes underlying stages through registered TAO skills
Treats the skill-root path as agent/runtime-resolved rather than user input
